_meta.description: 终端命令授权与高风险操作强制双语对照词库（每条译文必须保留原始英文，防止误批准高风险命令）

exact.Allow for this session: 本次会话允许 (Allow for this session)
exact.Allow for this conversation: 本次对话允许 (Allow for this conversation)
exact.Allow for this workspace: 当前工作区允许 (Allow for this workspace)
exact.Always allow this command: 始终允许此类命令 (Always allow this command)
exact.Always allow this tool: 始终允许此工具 (Always allow this tool)
exact.Allow in Sandbox: 允许在沙盒内执行 (Allow in Sandbox)
exact.Allow Outside Sandbox: 允许在沙盒外执行 (Allow Outside Sandbox)
exact.Run in Sandbox: 在沙盒内运行 (Run in Sandbox)
exact.Run Outside Sandbox: 在沙盒外运行 (Run Outside Sandbox)
exact.Run outside sandbox: 在沙盒外运行 (Run outside sandbox)
exact.Run outside the sandbox: 在沙盒外运行 (Run outside the sandbox)
exact.Push to Remote: 推送到远程仓库 (Push to Remote)
exact.Waiting for approval: 等待人工批准 (Waiting for approval)
exact.Waiting for your approval: 等待你的批准 (Waiting for your approval)
exact.Command requires approval: 该命令需要人工批准 (Command requires approval)
exact.Tool requires approval: 该工具调用需要人工批准 (Tool requires approval)
exact.Elevated permission required: 需要更高权限 (Elevated permission required)

exact.Wants to run a command: 请求执行终端命令 (Wants to run a command)
exact.Wants to access external network: 请求访问外部网络 (Wants to access external network)
exact.Are you sure you want to continue?: 确定要继续执行吗？ (Are you sure you want to continue?)
exact.Are you sure you want to delete this?: 确定要删除此项吗？ (Are you sure you want to delete this?)
警告：此操作不可撤销。 (This action cannot be undone.)
每条命令均需人工批准 (Every command requires approval.)
执行敏感操作前询问 (Ask before sensitive operations.)
由系统自动判断是否执行命令 (Automatically decide if commands run.)
高风险警告：无限制自动运行所有命令 (Run all commands without restrictions.)
exact.Undo to this point: 回滚到此节点 (Undo to this point)
exact.Interrupt the agent and send immediately: 中断智能体当前执行并立即发送 (Interrupt the agent and send immediately.)
exact.Terminal & Tooling Permissions: 终端与工具执行权限 (Terminal & Tooling Permissions)
exact.Commands Outside Sandbox: 沙盒外允许执行的命令 (Commands Outside Sandbox)
exact.Configure allowed commands outside the s: 高风险配置：设置允许在沙盒外执行的命令列表 (Configure allowed commands outside the sandbox.)
exact.Browser Javascript Execution Policy: 浏览器 JavaScript 执行策略 (Browser Javascript Execution Policy)
exact.Controls whether the agent can run custo: 控制智能体是否可在浏览器中执行自定义 JavaScript 以自动化操作 (Controls whether the agent can run custom JavaScript to automate complex browser actions.)
exact.Yes, allow this time: 是，仅允许这一次 (Yes, allow this time)
exact.No, deny this time: 否，拒绝这一次 (No, deny this time)
exact.Edit permission target: 编辑授权目标命令 (Edit permission target)
exact.(tell the agent what to do instead): （拒绝并告诉智能体改做什么 / tell the agent what to do instead）
exact.This undo action will not make any code: 此次撤销不会修改任何代码文件 (This undo action will not make any code changes.)
exact.Revert file changes: 同时回滚文件改动 (Revert file changes)
